<!doctype html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>AL Torrent Tools</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="/static/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml" />
  <link rel="shortcut icon" href="/favicon.ico" />
  <script src="/static/vendor/htmx-1.9.12.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; margin: 0; background: #121212; color: #eee; }
    header { padding: 12px 20px; background: #1f1f1f; }
    nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 16px; }
    nav a { color: #9ad1ff; text-decoration: none; }
    nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #fff; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9ad1ff; outline-offset: 3px; }
    .skip-link { position: fixed; top: 8px; left: 8px; z-index: 100; padding: 10px; background: #2c4f76; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-160%); }
    .skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }
    #ui-live-status { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; }
    #ui-action-error { margin-top: 12px; color: #ff8a80; }
    main { padding: 20px; }
    .card { background: #1b1b1b; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
    .grid > .card { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    .table-scroll { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
    .table-scroll > .pipeline-list-table { min-width: 1120px; }
    .jobs-live-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 3fr;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .jobs-live-grid > .card { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .jobs-live-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      main { padding: 12px; }
      .grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
      .row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
      form.row > .input { min-width: 0 !important; }
      .table-scroll > table { min-width: 760px; }
    }
    .jobs-catalog-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(320px, 100%), 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .job-catalog-card h3 { color: #9ad1ff; font-size: 1.05rem; }
    .job-card-meta { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .job-meta-line {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin: 2px 0;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .job-meta-icon {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      color: #9b9b9b;
    }
    .job-meta-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }
    .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .btn { background: #2c4f76; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; }
    .btn-icon {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      padding: 0;
      line-height: 0;
    }
    .btn-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; }
    .col-download { width: 48px; text-align: center; }
    .btn-secondary { background: #3a3a3a; }
    .btn-danger { background: #823b3b; }
    .input, select, textarea { width: 100%; background: #101010; color: #eee; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; }
    th, td { border-bottom: 1px solid #343434; padding: 8px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: break-word; }
    .log-toolbar { justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .log-toolbar h3 { margin: 0; }
    .log-panel {
      max-height: 70vh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      overflow-y: auto;
      background: #101010;
      border: 1px solid #333;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .log-line {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 2px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #1f1f1f;
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    .log-line:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
    .log-ts { color: #8a8a8a; flex: 0 0 auto; white-space: nowrap; }
    .log-level { flex: 0 0 56px; text-transform: lowercase; color: #9ad1ff; }
    .log-msg {
      flex: 1 1 0;
      min-width: 0;
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      word-break: break-word;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
    }
    .log-level-error { color: #ff8a80; }
    .log-level-warning { color: #ffcc80; }
    .log-level-debug { color: #6a6a6a; }
    .copy-status { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #8dffb0; }
    .muted { color: #9b9b9b; }
    .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
    .settings-group h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #9ad1ff; }
    .settings-group .grid { margin-top: 8px; }
    .settings-hint { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; }
    .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; width: fit-content; }
    .badge-ok { background: #1f3d2a; color: #8dffb0; }
    .badge-warn { background: #3d2f1f; color: #ffcc80; }
    .badge-danger { background: #3d1f1f; color: #ff8a80; }
    .badge-muted { background: #2a2a2a; color: #9b9b9b; }
    .job-status-running, .job-status-discovered, .job-status-waiting_master, .job-status-waiting_slave, .job-status-master_added, .job-status-master_complete, .job-status-slave_added { color: #ffcc80; }
    .job-status-stopping { color: #ffcc80; opacity: 0.85; }
    .job-status-partial, .job-status-sending { color: #ffcc80; }
    .tg-status-failed { color: #ff8a80; }
    .tg-status-cancelled { color: #9b9b9b; }
    .job-status-success, .job-status-done { color: #8dffb0; }
    .job-status-failed, .job-status-error { color: #ff8a80; }
    .job-status-cancelled, .job-status-pending { color: #9b9b9b; }
    .tg-status-skipped { color: #9b9b9b; }
    .tg-status-pending, .tg-status-queued { color: #ffcc80; }
    .tg-status-sent { color: #8dffb0; }
    .master-state-downloading { color: #9ad1ff; }
    .master-state-seeding { color: #8dffb0; }
    .master-state-stopped { color: #ffcc80; }
    .master-state-error { color: #ff8a80; }
    .master-state-missing, .master-state-unavailable { color: #9b9b9b; }
    .gl-pipeline-board {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-main-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-col-master { align-items: center; }
    .gl-pipeline-sm .gl-pipeline-col { min-width: 40px; }
    .gl-pipeline-lg .gl-pipeline-col { min-width: 72px; }
    .gl-pipeline-sm .gl-stage-label { font-size: 0.65rem; }
    .gl-pipeline-lg .gl-stage-label { font-size: 0.85rem; }
    .gl-pipeline-lg { margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .gl-pipeline-detail-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .gl-stage {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .gl-stage-side { opacity: 0.95; }
    .gl-pipeline-fork {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 0;
    }
    .gl-v-connector {
      width: 2px;
      height: 10px;
      background: #444;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-lg .gl-v-connector { height: 14px; }
    .gl-pipeline-fork-done {
      align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .gl-diag-connector {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      border-left: 2px solid #444;
      border-bottom: 2px solid #444;
      margin: 0 0 2px 5px;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-lg .gl-diag-connector {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      margin-left: 7px;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-fork-slave {
      align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-fork-check {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
    }
    .gl-fork-h-connector {
      flex: 0 0 14px;
      height: 2px;
      background: #444;
      margin: 6px 2px 0;
      align-self: flex-start;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-lg .gl-fork-h-connector {
      flex-basis: 22px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .gl-stage-dot {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid #666;
      background: #1b1b1b;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1;
      color: transparent;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-lg .gl-stage-dot { width: 18px; height: 18px; font-size: 13px; }
    .gl-stage-label { color: #9b9b9b; line-height: 1.1; white-space: nowrap; }
    .gl-stage-connector {
      flex: 0 0 18px;
      height: 2px;
      background: #444;
      margin: 6px 2px 0;
      align-self: flex-start;
    }
    .gl-pipeline-sm .gl-stage-connector { flex-basis: 10px; }
    .gl-pipeline-lg .gl-stage-connector { flex-basis: 28px; margin-top: 8px; }
    .gl-stage-pending .gl-stage-dot { border-color: #555; background: #222; }
    .gl-stage-pending .gl-stage-label { color: #666; }
    .gl-stage-skipped .gl-stage-dot {
      border-color: #444;
      background: #1a1a1a;
      color: #666;
    }
    .gl-stage-skipped .gl-stage-label { color: #555; }
    .gl-stage-running .gl-stage-dot {
      border-color: #1f75cb;
      background: #1f75cb;
      animation: gl-stage-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .gl-stage-running .gl-stage-label { color: #9ad1ff; }
    .gl-stage-success .gl-stage-dot { border-color: #2da160; background: #2da160; }
    .gl-stage-success .gl-stage-label { color: #8dffb0; }
    .gl-stage-failed .gl-stage-dot {
      border-color: #ec5941;
      background: #ec5941;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .gl-stage-failed .gl-stage-label { color: #ff8a80; }
    .gl-stage-cancelled .gl-stage-dot {
      border-color: #888;
      background: #555;
      color: #ddd;
    }
    .gl-stage-cancelled .gl-stage-label { color: #9b9b9b; }
    .gl-pipeline-status-text { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; margin-top: 4px; }
    .pipeline-list-table { width: 100%; table-layout: fixed; }
    .pipeline-list-table col.pipeline-col-id { width: 20rem; }
    .pipeline-list-table col.pipeline-col-release { width: auto; }
    .pipeline-list-table col.pipeline-col-torrent { width: 18rem; }
    .pipeline-list-table col.pipeline-col-graph { width: 20rem; }
    .pipeline-list-table th, .pipeline-list-table td {
      vertical-align: middle;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .pipeline-list-id {
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow-wrap: normal;
      word-break: normal;
    }
    .pipeline-list-hash {
      font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
      word-break: normal;
      overflow-wrap: normal;
      line-height: 1.25;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .pipeline-list-release,
    .pipeline-list-torrent {
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow-wrap: normal;
      word-break: normal;
    }
    .pipeline-list-graph {
      overflow: visible;
      overflow-wrap: normal;
      word-break: normal;
      white-space: normal;
    }
    .pipeline-list-graph .gl-pipeline-board {
      width: max-content;
    }
    @keyframes gl-stage-pulse {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(31, 117, 203, 0.55); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(31, 117, 203, 0); }
    }
    tr.row-selected td { background: #243044; }
    a { color: #9ad1ff; }
    code { background: #101010; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; }
    .release-block {
      background: #1b1b1b;
      border: 1px solid #333;
      border-radius: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .release-summary {
      list-style: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px 16px;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .release-summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
    .release-summary::before {
      content: "▸";
      color: #9ad1ff;
      margin-right: 8px;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }
    details[open] > .release-summary::before { content: "▾"; }
    .release-title {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
      flex: 1 1 220px;
      min-width: 0;
      user-select: text;
      -webkit-user-select: text;
    }
    .release-name-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .release-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .release-body { padding: 0 16px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #2a2a2a; }
    .genre-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .genre-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      background: #243044;
      color: #b8d4f0;
      border: 1px solid #354a66;
    }
    .member-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .member-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    .member-tag--voicing { background: #1a3d3a; color: #7fd4c8; border-color: #2a5c56; }
    .member-tag--editing { background: #3d321a; color: #e8c07a; border-color: #5c4a2a; }
    .member-tag--timing { background: #1f3d2a; color: #8dffb0; border-color: #2f5c3d; }
    .member-tag--translating { background: #1a2e4a; color: #8bb8f0; border-color: #2a4a6e; }
    .member-tag--decorating { background: #3d2420; color: #f0a090; border-color: #5c3830; }
    .member-tag--poster { background: #2a2e36; color: #c0c8d4; border-color: #3d4450; }
    .member-tag--hevc { background: #34234a; color: #d0a5ff; border-color: #51346e; }
    .member-tag--unknown { background: #2a2a2a; color: #9b9b9b; border-color: #3a3a3a; }
    .source-tag--site { background: #1f3d2a; color: #8dffb0; border-color: #2f5c3d; }
    .source-tag--backoffice { background: #3d1f1f; color: #ff8a80; border-color: #5c2f2f; }
    .info-table { width: 100%; table-layout: auto; }
    .info-table th {
      width: 140px;
      color: #9b9b9b;
      font-weight: normal;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .info-table td { border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a; }
    .info-table tr:last-child th,
    .info-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
    .pipeline-timeline {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .pipeline-timeline-item {
      border-left: 2px solid #354a66;
      padding: 0 0 2px 12px;
    }
    .pipeline-timeline-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px 12px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }
    .pipeline-timeline-message { margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .pipeline-timeline-links { font-size: 0.85rem; }
    .pipeline-event-details { margin-top: 4px; }
    .pipeline-event-details pre {
      margin: 6px 0 0;
      padding: 8px;
      background: #101010;
      border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
      border-radius: 6px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
    }
    tr.torrent-files-row td {
      padding-top: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #343434;
    }
    .torrent-files {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      padding: 6px 10px 8px;
      background: #141414;
      border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }
    .torrent-files summary { cursor: pointer; }
    .file-list {
      margin: 6px 0 0;
      padding-left: 16px;
      font-size: 0.9em;
      list-style: disc;
    }
    .file-list li { margin: 2px 0; }
    .file-list .file-download,
    .file-list .file-copy-path,
    .file-list .file-send-encoder,
    .file-list .file-mediainfo {
      display: inline-flex;
      vertical-align: middle;
      margin-left: 2px;
      color: #9ad1ff;
      text-decoration: none;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      padding: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .file-list .file-encode-check {
      vertical-align: middle;
      margin-right: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .file-list .file-download:hover,
    .file-list .file-copy-path:hover,
    .file-list .file-send-encoder:hover,
    .file-list .file-mediainfo:hover { color: #c5e4ff; }
    .file-list .file-download svg,
    .file-list .file-copy-path svg,
    .file-list .file-send-encoder svg,
    .file-list .file-mediainfo svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: currentColor; }
    .torrent-files summary {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .torrent-encode-select-actions {
      display: none;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      margin: 6px 0 4px;
    }
    /* Encoder UI: кнопки в DOM всегда (без jump после probe); без FOUC когда выключен. */
    [data-encoder-enabled="1"] .torrent-encode-select-actions {
      display: flex;
    }
    .torrent-encode-select-actions[hidden] { display: none !important; }
    .btn-link {
      background: none;
      border: 0;
      padding: 0;
      color: #9ad1ff;
      cursor: pointer;
      font: inherit;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
    .btn-link:hover { color: #c5e4ff; }
    #encoder-preset-dialog {
      border: 1px solid #444;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #1b1b1b;
      color: #eee;
      padding: 16px;
      min-width: min(400px, 92vw);
    }
    #encoder-preset-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); }
    #encoder-preset-dialog .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    #encoder-preset-dialog .field {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    #encoder-preset-dialog select.input { min-width: 220px; width: 100%; }
    #encoder-batch-bar {
      position: fixed;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      z-index: 40;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      background: #1b1b1b;
      border-top: 1px solid #444;
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }
    #encoder-batch-bar.is-visible { display: flex; }
    #encoder-batch-bar .encoder-batch-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    #encoder-batch-bar .encoder-batch-status {
      color: #aaa;
      font-size: 0.9em;
      min-width: 0;
      flex: 1 1 160px;
    }
    body.has-encoder-batch-bar { padding-bottom: 64px; }

    #mediainfo-dialog {
      border: 1px solid #444;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #1e1e1e;
      color: #eee;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      width: min(860px, 95vw);
      max-height: 88vh;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    /* display:flex ломает UA-правило dialog:not([open]){display:none} — окно остаётся внизу страницы */
    #mediainfo-dialog[open] {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    #mediainfo-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65); }

  function formatApiErrorDetail(detail) {
    if (detail == null || detail === "") return null;
    if (typeof detail === "string") return detail;
    if (Array.isArray(detail)) {
      return detail
        .map((item) => {
          if (typeof item === "string") return item;
          if (item && typeof item === "object") {
            const loc = Array.isArray(item.loc)
              ? item.loc.filter((part) => part !== "body").join(".")
              : "";
            const msg = item.msg || JSON.stringify(item);
            return loc ? `${loc}: ${msg}` : msg;
          }
          return String(item);
        })
        .join("; ");
    }
    if (typeof detail === "object") {
      const parts = [];
      const main =
        detail.message || detail.msg || detail.error || null;
      if (main) parts.push(String(main));
      if (Array.isArray(detail.local_errors) && detail.local_errors.length) {
        const brief = detail.local_errors
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map((item) => {
            if (!item) return "";
            if (typeof item === "string") return item;
            return item.error ? String(item.error) : "";
          })
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join("; ");
        const extra =
          detail.local_errors.length > 3
            ? ` (+${detail.local_errors.length - 3})`
            : "";
        if (brief) parts.push(brief + extra);
      }
      if (parts.length) return parts.join(" — ");
      return JSON.stringify(detail);
    }
    return String(detail);
  }

  function syncEncoderDownmixLock(audioSelect, downmixSelect) {
    const audioId = (audioSelect.value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const lockStereo = audioId === "copy" || audioId === "none";
    const stereoOpt = [...downmixSelect.options].find((o) => o.value === "stereo");
    if (stereoOpt) stereoOpt.disabled = lockStereo;
    if (lockStereo && downmixSelect.value === "stereo") {
      downmixSelect.value = "none";

  }

  function fillEncoderLayerSelect(select, items, preferredId) {
    select.innerHTML = "";
    const appendOption = (p) => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = p.id;
      const name = p.name || p.id;
      opt.textContent = p.id && p.id !== name ? `${name} (${p.id})` : name;
      if (p.available === false) {
        opt.disabled = true;
        opt.textContent += " — недоступен";
      }
      if (p.default === true) opt.dataset.default = "1";
      select.appendChild(opt);
    };
    (items || []).forEach(appendOption);
    const preferred = (preferredId || "").trim();
    if (preferred) {
      const match = [...select.options].find((o) => o.value === preferred && !o.disabled);
      if (match) {
        select.value = preferred;
        return;
      }
    }
    const defaultOpt = [...select.options].find((o) => !o.disabled && o.dataset.default === "1");
    if (defaultOpt) {
      select.value = defaultOpt.value;
      return;
    }
    const firstEnabled = [...select.options].find((o) => !o.disabled);
    if (firstEnabled) select.value = firstEnabled.value;
  }

  async function pickEncoderPreset() {
    const dialog = ensureEncoderPresetDialog();
    const videoSelect = dialog.querySelector("#encoder-video-select");
    const audioSelect = dialog.querySelector("#encoder-audio-select");
    const downmixSelect = dialog.querySelector("#encoder-downmix-select");

    if (!resp.ok) {
      const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(formatApiErrorDetail(err.detail) || `HTTP ${resp.status}`);

    const data = await resp.json();

    if (!videos.length) throw new Error("Видео-пресеты не найдены");
    if (!audios.length) throw new Error("Аудио-пресеты не найдены");

    const defaults = data.defaults || {};
    fillEncoderLayerSelect(videoSelect, videos, defaults.video_id);
    fillEncoderLayerSelect(audioSelect, audios, defaults.audio_id);
    const preferredDownmix =
      defaults.audio_downmix === "stereo" ? "stereo" : "none";
    downmixSelect.value = preferredDownmix;
    syncEncoderDownmixLock(audioSelect, downmixSelect);

  function encoderRequestId(signature, fresh) {
    const storageKey = "altt.encoder.request." + signature;

      _encoderRequestKeys.set(signature, id);

    const signature = JSON.stringify({ids:[...fileIds].sort((a,b)=>a-b), ...layers, retry_of:options.retry_of || null});
    const body = {file_ids:fileIds, ...layers, ...options, request_id:encoderRequestId(signature, !!options.fresh)};

    delete body.noRepeatPrompt;
    const send = () => fetch("/api/torrent-files/send-to-encoder", {
      method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json", Accept:"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    let resp = await send();
    let payload = await resp.json().catch(()=>({}));
    const previous = payload.detail && payload.detail.previous;
    if (resp.status === 409 && Array.isArray(previous) && previous.length && !options.noRepeatPrompt) {
      const active = previous.some(x=>x.status==="sending");
      const unknown = previous.some(x=>x.status==="unknown");
      const acceptedCount = previous.filter(x=>x.status==="accepted").length;
      const unknownCount = previous.filter(x=>x.status==="unknown").length;

        acceptedCount ? `Уже приняты Kensetsu с этими пресетами: ${acceptedCount}.` : "",
        unknownCount ? `Приём не подтверждён: ${unknownCount}. Сначала проверьте Kensetsu: повтор может создать ещё одно задание.` : "",
        "Отправить все выбранные файлы ещё раз?"

        body.allow_repeat = true;
        body.acknowledge_unknown = unknown;
        resp = await send();
        payload = await resp.json().catch(()=>({}));
      }
    }
    if (!resp.ok) {
      const priorId = Array.isArray(previous) && previous.find(item => Number.isInteger(item.submission_id))?.submission_id;
      const id = resp.headers.get("X-Encoder-Submission-Id") || priorId;
      const message = formatApiErrorDetail(payload.detail) || `HTTP ${resp.status}`;

      await refreshEncoderReceipts();

      _encoderRequestKeys.delete(signature);
      try { sessionStorage.removeItem("altt.encoder.request." + signature); } catch (_) {}
    }
    await refreshEncoderReceipts();
    return payload;

    try {
      const slots = [...document.querySelectorAll(".file-download-slot[data-file-id]")];
      const ids = [...new Set(slots.map(el=>Number(el.dataset.fileId)).filter(Number.isFinite))];
      for (let offset=0; offset<ids.length; offset+=100) {
        const chunk = ids.slice(offset,offset+100);
        const resp = await fetch("/api/encoder-submissions/receipts", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({file_ids:chunk})});
        if (!resp.ok) continue;
        const data = await resp.json();
        slots.filter(slot=>chunk.includes(Number(slot.dataset.fileId))).forEach(slot=>{
          let link = slot.parentElement.querySelector(`.file-encoder-history[data-file-id="${slot.dataset.fileId}"]`);
          const receipt = (data.receipts || {})[slot.dataset.fileId];
          if (!receipt) { if (link) link.remove(); return; }

            link = document.createElement("a");
            link.className = "file-encoder-history muted";
            link.dataset.fileId = slot.dataset.fileId;
            link.style.marginLeft = "8px";
            slot.after(link);
          }
          link.href = receipt.history_url;
          link.textContent = "Kensetsu: " + receipt.label;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) { /* The durable journal remains available if a badge refresh fails. */ }
    finally {
      _encoderReceiptBusy = false;
      if (_encoderReceiptAgain) { _encoderReceiptAgain=false; setTimeout(refreshEncoderReceipts,0); }
    }
  }

  function formatMediaInfoFileSize(val) {
    if (val == null || val === "") return "";
    if (typeof val === "string" && !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(val.trim())) return val;
    const num = Number(val);
    if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num <= 0) return "";
    if (num >= 1073741824) return `${(num / 1073741824).toFixed(2)} ГиБ`;
    if (num >= 1048576) return `${(num / 1048576).toFixed(1)} МиБ`;
    if (num >= 1024) return `${Math.round(num / 1024)} КиБ`;
    return `${Math.round(num)} Б`;
  }

  function attachmentRowClass(name, mime) {
    // Правила проекта: ttf/ttc → application/x-truetype-font; otf → application/vnd.ms-opentype.
    // Пустой MIME — данные ещё не получены, строку не красим.
    const lower = String(name || "").toLowerCase();
    const m = String(mime || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!m) return "";
    let expected = null;
    if (lower.endsWith(".ttf") || lower.endsWith(".ttc")) {
      expected = "application/x-truetype-font";
    } else if (lower.endsWith(".otf")) {
      expected = "application/vnd.ms-opentype";
    } else {
      return "mi-att-nonfont";
    }
    if (m === expected) return "";
    return "mi-att-mismatch";
  }

      ["changed", "изменён", "изменённые", "изменённых"],
      ["checking", "проверка", "проверки", "проверок"],
      ["ok", "старый", "старые", "старых"],

  function chunkHashes(hashes, size) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < hashes.length; i += size) out.push(hashes.slice(i, i + size));

  async function postDownloadableProbe(hashes, refresh, byHash) {
    if (!hashes.length) return;
    const chunks = chunkHashes(hashes, _DOWNLOAD_PROBE_CHUNK);
    for (const chunk of chunks) {
      const chunkBlocks = [];
      chunk.forEach((hash) => {
        (byHash.get(hash) || []).forEach((block) => chunkBlocks.push(block));
      });
      try {
        const resp = await fetch("/api/torrents/downloadable-files", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ hashes: chunk, refresh: !!refresh }),
        });
        if (!resp.ok) {
          clearDownloadQueued(chunkBlocks);
          continue;
        }
        const payload = await resp.json();
        (payload.items || []).forEach((item) => {
          const hash = item.info_hash;
          if (!hash) return;
          cacheDownloadableProbe(hash, item);
          (byHash.get(hash) || []).forEach((block) => {
            applyDownloadableProbe(block, item);
            // Пустой ответ — не блокируем повторный enqueue (Hash backfill / retry).
            if (probeResultIsEmpty(item)) {
              block.removeAttribute("data-download-queued");
            }
          });
        });
      } catch (_) {
        clearDownloadQueued(chunkBlocks);
      }
    }
  }

  async function pumpDownloadableQueue() {
    if (_downloadCheckBusy) return;
    _downloadCheckBusy = true;
    while (_downloadCheckQueue.length) {
      const batch = _downloadCheckQueue.splice(0, _downloadCheckQueue.length);
      const byHash = new Map();
      const refreshHashes = [];
      const dbOnlyHashes = [];
      const seenRefresh = new Set();
      const seenDb = new Set();
      batch.forEach((block) => {
        const hash = block.getAttribute("data-download-check");
        if (!hash) return;
        if (!byHash.has(hash)) byHash.set(hash, []);
        byHash.get(hash).push(block);
      });
      byHash.forEach((blocks, hash) => {
        const wantRefresh = blocks.some((b) => b.getAttribute("data-download-refresh") === "1");
        if (wantRefresh) {
          if (!seenRefresh.has(hash)) {
            seenRefresh.add(hash);
            refreshHashes.push(hash);
          }
        } else if (!seenDb.has(hash)) {
          seenDb.add(hash);
          dbOnlyHashes.push(hash);
        }
      });
      // refresh не должен заражать весь батч: две группы запросов.
      await postDownloadableProbe(refreshHashes, true, byHash);
      await postDownloadableProbe(dbOnlyHashes, false, byHash);
    }
    _downloadCheckBusy = false;
  }

  function formatApiErrorDetail(detail) {
    if (detail == null || detail === "") return null;
    if (typeof detail === "string") return detail;
    if (Array.isArray(detail)) {
      return detail
        .map((item) => {
          if (typeof item === "string") return item;
          if (item && typeof item === "object") {
            const loc = Array.isArray(item.loc)
              ? item.loc.filter((part) => part !== "body").join(".")
              : "";
            const msg = item.msg || JSON.stringify(item);
            return loc ? `${loc}: ${msg}` : msg;
          }
          return String(item);
        })
        .join("; ");
    }
    if (typeof detail === "object") {
      const parts = [];
      const main =
        detail.message || detail.msg || detail.error || null;
      if (main) parts.push(String(main));
      if (Array.isArray(detail.local_errors) && detail.local_errors.length) {
        const brief = detail.local_errors
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map((item) => {
            if (!item) return "";
            if (typeof item === "string") return item;
            return item.error ? String(item.error) : "";
          })
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join("; ");
        const extra =
          detail.local_errors.length > 3
            ? ` (+${detail.local_errors.length - 3})`
            : "";
        if (brief) parts.push(brief + extra);
      }
      if (parts.length) return parts.join(" — ");
      return JSON.stringify(detail);
    }
    return String(detail);
  }

    const dialog = ensureEncoderPresetDialog();
    const videoSelect = dialog.querySelector("#encoder-video-select");

      const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(formatApiErrorDetail(err.detail) || `HTTP ${resp.status}`);
    }
    const data = await resp.json();
    const videos = data.videos || [];
    const audios = data.audios || [];
    if (!videos.length) throw new Error("Видео-пресеты не найдены");
    if (!audios.length) throw new Error("Аудио-пресеты не найдены");

    const defaults = data.defaults || {};
    fillEncoderLayerSelect(videoSelect, videos, defaults.video_id);
    fillEncoderLayerSelect(audioSelect, audios, defaults.audio_id);
    const preferredDownmix =
      defaults.audio_downmix === "stereo" ? "stereo" : "none";

    syncEncoderDownmixLock(audioSelect, downmixSelect);

    const onAudioChange = () => syncEncoderDownmixLock(audioSelect, downmixSelect);

    dialog.returnValue = "";
    dialog.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const onClose = () => {
        dialog.removeEventListener("close", onClose);
        audioSelect.removeEventListener("change", onAudioChange);
        if (dialog.returnValue === "ok") {
          const videoOpt = videoSelect.selectedOptions[0];
          const audioOpt = audioSelect.selectedOptions[0];
          if (!videoOpt || videoOpt.disabled || !audioOpt || audioOpt.disabled) {

        } else {
          resolve(null);
        }
      };
      dialog.addEventListener("close", onClose);
    });
  }

  const _encoderRequestKeys = new Map();
  function encoderRequestId(signature, fresh) {
    const storageKey = "altt.encoder.request." + signature;
    let id = !fresh && _encoderRequestKeys.get(signature);
    try { if (!id && !fresh) id = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey); } catch (_) {}
    if (!id) {
      id = globalThis.crypto && crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() :
        "request-" + Date.now().toString(36) + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
      _encoderRequestKeys.set(signature, id);
      try { sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, id); } catch (_) {}
    }
    return id;
  }

  async function submitEncoderFiles(fileIds, layers, options = {}) {
    const signature = JSON.stringify({ids:[...fileIds].sort((a,b)=>a-b), ...layers, retry_of:options.retry_of || null});
    const body = {file_ids:fileIds, ...layers, ...options, request_id:encoderRequestId(signature, !!options.fresh)};
    delete body.fresh;
    delete body.noRepeatPrompt;
    const send = () => fetch("/api/torrent-files/send-to-encoder", {
      method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json", Accept:"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    let resp = await send();
    let payload = await resp.json().catch(()=>({}));
    const previous = payload.detail && payload.detail.previous;
    if (resp.status === 409 && Array.isArray(previous) && previous.length && !options.noRepeatPrompt) {
      const active = previous.some(x=>x.status==="sending");
      const unknown = previous.some(x=>x.status==="unknown");
      const acceptedCount = previous.filter(x=>x.status==="accepted").length;
      const unknownCount = previous.filter(x=>x.status==="unknown").length;
      const repeatMessage = [
        acceptedCount ? `Уже приняты Kensetsu с этими пресетами: ${acceptedCount}.` : "",
        unknownCount ? `Приём не подтверждён: ${unknownCount}. Сначала проверьте Kensetsu: повтор может создать ещё одно задание.` : "",
        "Отправить все выбранные файлы ещё раз?"
      ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
      if (!active && confirm(repeatMessage)) {
        body.allow_repeat = true;
        body.acknowledge_unknown = unknown;
        resp = await send();
        payload = await resp.json().catch(()=>({}));
      }
    }
    if (!resp.ok) {
      const priorId = Array.isArray(previous) && previous.find(item => Number.isInteger(item.submission_id))?.submission_id;
      const id = resp.headers.get("X-Encoder-Submission-Id") || priorId;
      const message = formatApiErrorDetail(payload.detail) || `HTTP ${resp.status}`;
      const error = new Error(message + (id ? ` · история отправки #${id}` : ""));
      error.historyUrl = id ? `/encoder-history?submission_id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}` : null;
      await refreshEncoderReceipts();
      throw error;
    }
    if (!(payload.counts && (payload.counts.sending || payload.counts.unknown))) {
      _encoderRequestKeys.delete(signature);
      try { sessionStorage.removeItem("altt.encoder.request." + signature); } catch (_) {}
    }
    await refreshEncoderReceipts();
    return payload;
  }

  let _encoderReceiptBusy = false;
  let _encoderReceiptAgain = false;
  async function refreshEncoderReceipts() {
    if (_encoderReceiptBusy) { _encoderReceiptAgain = true; return; }
    _encoderReceiptBusy = true;
    try {
      const slots = [...document.querySelectorAll(".file-download-slot[data-file-id]")];
      const ids = [...new Set(slots.map(el=>Number(el.dataset.fileId)).filter(Number.isFinite))];
      for (let offset=0; offset<ids.length; offset+=100) {
        const chunk = ids.slice(offset,offset+100);
        const resp = await fetch("/api/encoder-submissions/receipts", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({file_ids:chunk})});
        if (!resp.ok) continue;
        const data = await resp.json();
        slots.filter(slot=>chunk.includes(Number(slot.dataset.fileId))).forEach(slot=>{
          let link = slot.parentElement.querySelector(`.file-encoder-history[data-file-id="${slot.dataset.fileId}"]`);
          const receipt = (data.receipts || {})[slot.dataset.fileId];
          if (!receipt) { if (link) link.remove(); return; }
          if (!link) {
            link = document.createElement("a");
            link.className = "file-encoder-history muted";
            link.dataset.fileId = slot.dataset.fileId;
            link.style.marginLeft = "8px";
            slot.after(link);
          }
          link.href = receipt.history_url;
          link.textContent = "Kensetsu: " + receipt.label;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) { /* The durable journal remains available if a badge refresh fails. */ }
    finally {
      _encoderReceiptBusy = false;
      if (_encoderReceiptAgain) { _encoderReceiptAgain=false; setTimeout(refreshEncoderReceipts,0); }
    }
  }

    document.body.appendChild(dialog);
    dialog.querySelector("#mi-modal-close").addEventListener("click", () => dialog.close());
    let backdropMouseDown = false;
    function isBackdropClick(e) {
      if (e.target !== dialog) return false;
      const r = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
      return e.clientX < r.left || e.clientX > r.right || e.clientY < r.top || e.clientY > r.bottom;
    }
    dialog.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
      backdropMouseDown = isBackdropClick(e);
    });
    dialog.addEventListener("mouseup", (e) => {
      if (backdropMouseDown && isBackdropClick(e)) dialog.close();
      backdropMouseDown = false;
    });
    return dialog;
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    if (!str) return "";
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, "&")
      .replace(/</g, "<")
      .replace(/>/g, ">")
      .replace(/"/g, """)
      .replace(/'/g, "'");
  }

  function formatMediaInfoFileSize(val) {
    if (val == null || val === "") return "";
    if (typeof val === "string" && !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(val.trim())) return val;
    const num = Number(val);
    if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num <= 0) return "";
    if (num >= 1073741824) return `${(num / 1073741824).toFixed(2)} ГиБ`;
    if (num >= 1048576) return `${(num / 1048576).toFixed(1)} МиБ`;
    if (num >= 1024) return `${Math.round(num / 1024)} КиБ`;
    return `${Math.round(num)} Б`;
  }

  async function loadMediaInfoData(fileId, container, force) {
    try {
      const url = force
        ? `/api/torrent-files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}/mediainfo/refresh`
        : `/api/torrent-files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}/mediainfo`;
      const method = force ? "POST" : "GET";
      const resp = await fetch(url, { method });
      const data = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (!resp.ok) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="badge badge-danger" style="padding:10px;display:block;margin:10px 0;">Ошибка: ${escapeHtml(data.detail || `HTTP ${resp.status}`)}</div>`;
        return;
      }

      if (data.status !== "ready") {
        let warnText = data.error || "Информация о файле пока недоступна.";
        if (data.status === "in_progress") {
          warnText = "Файл проверяется или ещё загружается на master.";
        } else if (data.status === "file_missing") {
          warnText = "Файл ещё не скачан или отсутствует на диске.";
        }
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div style="padding:18px;text-align:center;">
            <p class="muted" style="margin-bottom:12px;">${escapeHtml(warnText)}</p>
            <button class="btn btn-secondary" id="mi-retry-btn" type="button">Попробовать снова</button>
          </div>
        `;
        container.querySelector("#mi-retry-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
          container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:24px 0;text-align:center;color:#888;">Повторная попытка…</div>';
          loadMediaInfoData(fileId, container, true);
        });
        return;
      }

      renderMediaInfoContent(container, data, fileId);
    } catch (err) {
      container.innerHTML = `<div class="badge badge-danger" style="padding:10px;display:block;margin:10px 0;">Ошибка сети: ${escapeHtml(err.message)}</div>`;
    }
  }

  function attachmentRowClass(name, mime) {
    // Правила проекта: ttf/ttc → application/x-truetype-font; otf → application/vnd.ms-opentype.
    // Пустой MIME — данные ещё не получены, строку не красим.
    const lower = String(name || "").toLowerCase();
    const m = String(mime || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!m) return "";
    let expected = null;
    if (lower.endsWith(".ttf") || lower.endsWith(".ttc")) {
      expected = "application/x-truetype-font";
    } else if (lower.endsWith(".otf")) {
      expected = "application/vnd.ms-opentype";
    } else {
      return "mi-att-nonfont";
    }
    if (m === expected) return "";
    return "mi-att-mismatch";
  }

  function attachmentRowTitle(name, mime) {
    const lower = String(name || "").toLowerCase();
    const m = String(mime || "").trim();
    if (!m) return "";
    let expected = null;
    if (lower.endsWith(".ttf") || lower.endsWith(".ttc")) {
      expected = "application/x-truetype-font";
    } else if (lower.endsWith(".otf")) {
      expected = "application/vnd.ms-opentype";
    } else {
      return "Не шрифт проекта (ожидаются .ttf / .ttc / .otf)";
    }
    if (m.toLowerCase() === expected) return "";
    return `Ожидался MIME ${expected}, в файле: ${m}`;
  }

  function _ruPluralFiles(n, one, few, many) {
    const nAbs = Math.abs(n) % 100;
    const n1 = nAbs % 10;
    if (nAbs >= 11 && nAbs <= 19) return many;
    if (n1 === 1) return one;
    if (n1 >= 2 && n1 <= 4) return few;
    return many;
  }

  function formatTorrentFilesSummaryFromStatuses(statuses) {
    const counts = { new: 0, changed: 0, checking: 0, ok: 0, removed: 0 };
    (statuses || []).forEach((raw) => {
      const status = String(raw || "ok").toLowerCase();
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(counts, status)) counts[status] += 1;
      else counts.ok += 1;
    });
    const active = counts.new + counts.changed + counts.checking + counts.ok;
    const removed = counts.removed;
    if (active === 0) {
      if (removed === 0) return "0 файлов.";
      return `${removed} ${_ruPluralFiles(removed, "удалён", "удалённых", "удалённых")}.`;
    }
    let head = `${active} ${_ruPluralFiles(active, "файл", "файла", "файлов")}`;
    const order = [
      ["new", "новый", "новые", "новых"],
      ["changed", "изменён", "изменённые", "изменённых"],
      ["checking", "проверка", "проверки", "проверок"],
      ["ok", "старый", "старые", "старых"],
    ];
    const detail = order
      .filter(([key]) => counts[key])
      .map(([key, one, few, many]) => `${counts[key]} ${_ruPluralFiles(counts[key], one, few, many)}`);
    const interesting = counts.new || counts.changed || counts.checking || removed;
    if (interesting && detail.length) head += ` (${detail.join(", ")})`;
    if (removed) {
      head += `, ${removed} ${_ruPluralFiles(removed, "удалён", "удалённых", "удалённых")}`;
    }
    return `${head}.`;
  }

  function refreshTorrentFilesSummary(block) {

    const textEl = (details || block).querySelector(".torrent-files-summary-text");

    const listRoot = block.querySelector("ul.file-list") || block;
    const statuses = [];
    listRoot.querySelectorAll("li .file-ui-badge[data-ui-status]").forEach((badge) => {
      statuses.push(badge.getAttribute("data-ui-status") || "ok");
    });
    // Fallback: бейджи без data-ui-status (старый HTML до деплоя).
    if (!statuses.length) {
      listRoot.querySelectorAll("li .file-ui-badge").forEach((badge) => {
        const t = (badge.textContent || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        if (t === "новый") statuses.push("new");
        else if (t === "изменён") statuses.push("changed");
        else if (t === "проверка") statuses.push("checking");
        else if (t === "удалён") statuses.push("removed");
        else statuses.push("ok");
